svg.title: Nesso-1 architecture: coarse-grained cofolding for affinity prediction
svg.desc: Five columns preserve the detailed reference layout. Dashed conditioning routes occupy empty gutters. Entropy is a diagnostic branch and does not feed the affinity model.
svg.text: Nesso-1 architecture: coarse-grained cofolding for affinity prediction
Pairwise token geometry is the central latent representation; no MSA stack and no all-atom diffusion decoder.
same stack reused at each pass
from ligand, subject to token budget
A probability distribution over coarse pairwise distances,
No side-chain coordinate decoder · No heavy-atom diffusion module
